data.narrative:
Hypersonix Launch Systems is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $46M AUD to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $46M raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $92M. Peer-median analysis across the three closest same-stage, same-sector comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects material differences in technology maturity and market positioning within the defense tech subsector.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $78M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $246M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables drive the upper estimate. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the $4.0B Stark Defence comparable—which may reflect venture investor enthusiasm outliers—and Hypersonix's relative technological differentiation versus the peer set. A mid-range estimate of $200M–$300M appears most defensible absent material new technical validation or customer commitments.
